assessment.mechanism: URL and email regexes end with $, which permits a match before a final newline. Validation therefore accepts URL/email strings containing a trailing newline, including the email local-part before @. Replacing these anchors with strict end-of-string \Z rejects those inputs.
assessment.evidence_reason: Five saved base tests fail because ValidationError is not raised: three URL variants with trailing newline and two email variants with a newline before @ or at the end. The same132test nodes pass fixed. Product repair changes exactly the relevant end anchors; full original test patch/source inventories, local reference statuses, log hashes and cleanup verified.
assessment.limitations: The URL regex is defined inside existing URL.RegexMemoizer._regex_generator (base53-69, changed68). Email regex constants are initialized in the class body (base121-135), represented by the schema module fallback rather than falsely naming the unmodified Email.__call__ as the definition. Module location is coarse and does not distinguish class attributes. No exploit or security impact measured; source issue is context, not historical CI evidence. Original unresolved-ID run retained; sole correction changes mapping only, not test behavior.
assessment.input_leakage_review: FrozenV5 source/log only; issue, repair/test patch, source-parser audit and assessment not supplied to retrieval. Existing comments and exception/assertion messages are evidence, not automatic answer leakage.
